values only in the copy stay (kept_from_copy), differing values stay on both (values_differ)  #> R9 : negative value of a non-negative quantity = missing (SOTWIS codes, WISE CACO3 -1); the code in revised_markings.hidden_values  #> R10 : WISE 'Not measured' per laboratory and property: zeros of group 1 = nodata (groups 2 and 3 only flagged)  #> R11 : WISE ECE 0.1 in profiles all at 0.1: flag uniform_profile_value (no exclusion)  #> R12 : values impossible for the declared unit excluded; extremes flagged extreme; WoSIS PHPRTN above 100 flagged above_unit_maximum  #> R14 : SOTER: empty rows skipped by layer=first; Nepal top_depth_cm from the first number of HBDE_ORIGINAL (top_depth_from_hbde_original, open_ended)  #> R15 : SOTER orphan horizons whose PRID differs only by case joined to the existing profile  #> R16 : WoSIS sand + silt + clay rescaled to 100 (texture_normalized with the original sum)  #> R17 : WoSIS BDFIFM elements 'guessed value, expert field estimate' excluded (the cell disappears when none remains)  #> R18 : SOVEUR v1 layers equal to the v2 T1S1D1 layer of the same unit hidden (both versions are in sotwis_polygons)  #> R19 : SOTWIS TCEQ above 120 where declared g C kg-1: flag impossible_for_declared_unit (no exclusion)
